name: Loot
description: After divorcing her husband of 20 years, Molly Novak must figure out what to do with her $87 billion settlement. She decides to reengage with her charitable foundation and reconnect with the real world—finding herself along the way.

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: Molly Novak's life is thrown into upheaval when she discovers her billionaire husband is cheating on her.

videos.title: Bienvenidos a Miami
videos.overview: On her first day of work at The Wells Foundation, Molly tries to fit in with Sofia and the rest of the team.

videos.title: Hot Seat
videos.overview: When John gives an interview questioning her substance, Molly and her co-workers decide to hit back. Howard makes a discovery about Nicholas.

videos.title: Excitement Park
videos.overview: Arthur helps Molly sort through her financial portfolio after she realizes she owns several problematic companies.

videos.title: Halsa
videos.overview: Molly takes some of her co-workers on a high-end spa day. Arthur seeks relationship advice from Nicholas and Howard.

videos.title: The Philanthropic Humanitarian Awards
videos.overview: The Wells Foundation team attends a ceremony where Molly is receiving an award for her charity work.

videos.title: French Connection
videos.overview: Molly travels to Jean-Pierre's vineyard for a date...or is it? Howard wants Nicholas to meet his girlfriend, Tanya.

videos.title: Spades Night
videos.overview: Molly asks Howard to help repair her relationship with their family. Sofia has an unexpected visitor.

videos.title: Cahoga Lake
videos.overview: The Wells Foundation team receives exciting news from both Molly and Sofia. Nicholas gets a new opportunity.

videos.title: The Silver Moon Summit
videos.overview: At the Silver Moon Summit in Corsica, Molly must make a choice between her past and her future.

videos.title: Space for Everyone
videos.overview: Molly and the Wells Foundation team struggle to live up to her promise to donate the entirety of her vast fortune. Arthur has a new lease on life.

videos.title: Clueless
videos.overview: As Molly moves forward with the Space for Everyone project, Sofia butts heads with its architect. Howard asks Arthur for financial advice.

videos.title: Vengeance Falls
videos.overview: When Nicholas' new play premieres, Molly brings some surprise visitors. Howard suspects Sofia is hiding a secret.

videos.title: Mr. Congeniality
videos.overview: Molly attends a meditation retreat. Howard and Arthur audition wrestlers for their new league. Ainsley asks Sofia and Nicholas for wedding help.

videos.title: Mally's
videos.overview: Arthur and Molly try to sell her megayacht to a Swedish billionaire. Sofia and rest of the team hit the streets to collect signatures.

videos.title: Women Who Rule
videos.overview: It's LA Fashion Week—and Molly is asked to walk the runway. Sofia faces commitment issues with Isaac. Arthur asks Howard for style advice.

videos.title: Camp Wells
videos.overview: Molly and Nicholas plan a work retreat for the Wells Foundation crew. Sofia and Howard struggle with the outdoors.

videos.title: Grace
videos.overview: Sofia and Molly try to recruit another billionaire for their cause. Nicholas needs Howard's help to prepare for a difficult audition.

videos.title: Mood Vibrations
videos.overview: As Space For Everyone becomes a reality, Molly's ex-husband tries to steal the spotlight. Sofia struggles to balance work and her relationship.

videos.title: We Shouldn't Exist
videos.overview: While Molly and the Wells Foundation are on the precipice of their greatest success, the team faces big personal decisions.

videos.title: Bye-Bye Mode
videos.overview: The Wells Foundation team tracks Molly down on a private island to convince her to return—but they're not alone.

videos.title: Would Hit
videos.overview: Molly and Arthur go on their first official date. Sofia's chaotic sister Destiny reenters her life.

videos.title: Lady Molly
videos.overview: After Molly is deepfaked, she scrambles to restore her reputation by accepting an award at a charity cricket match in England.

videos.title: Buona Sera
videos.overview: At Arthur's urging, Molly decides to make peace with her ex-husband. Howard recruits Nicholas and Ainsley to help him impress Destiny.

videos.title: Joyride
videos.overview: Molly uses her vast resources to give Nicholas the perfect day, along the way remembering how they first met.

videos.title: What's Up with Us
videos.overview: Arthur invites Molly on a birding trip with his friends. Sofia discovers that Howard and Destiny have started dating.

videos.title: Billionaire, Beautiful and True
videos.overview: As Molly struggles with relationship problems, Howard realizes she needs Nicholas. Arthur invites Sofia to join his gaming club.

videos.title: Mr. Maro Gold
videos.overview: An extremely attractive offer lands on Molly's doorstep. Howard and Destiny present a business proposal to Sofia.

videos.title: Slide
videos.overview: Molly settles into a new relationship. Arthur questions his life choices with Nicholas and Howard.

videos.title: Hail Mary Time
videos.overview: Molly and the team crash an Italian wedding in a desperate attempt to save The Wells Foundation from Luciana.

awards: Nominated for 1 Primetime Emmy. 2 wins & 13 nominations total
